description: Write /data/{name}.json on the live site without a deploy (Pro/Scale). Page JS keeps fetch("/data/{name}.json"). JSON must be an object or array, max 256 KB. Include the file in the next deploy or a repo upload that omits it can wipe it. Do not store secrets — the URL is public. Free: upload the JSON and call deploy instead.

json.description: JSON object/array, or a JSON string of the same.

name.description: Collection name only (e.g. menu). Becomes /data/menu.json. Letters, digits, _ or -.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

name: put_site_data
title: Put live site JSON
